name: vscode-flatbuffers
description: Syntax highlighting and format-on-save for FlatBuffers (.fbs) schema files. Format provider delegates to the flatbuffers-format engine.
author: emindeniz99

flatbuffers.format.indent.description: Indent count per level. Forwarded to flatbuffers-format's `indent` option. With `useTabs`, this is the number of tabs per level.

flatbuffers.format.useTabs.description: Use literal tab characters for indentation instead of spaces.

flatbuffers.format.lineWidth.description: Target column for compact/wrap decisions. Drives the engine's `lineWidth` option.

flatbuffers.format.compactSingleLine.description: Collapse small enum/union/single-field bodies onto one line when they fit in `lineWidth`.

flatbuffers.format.maxBlankLines.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines preserved between top-level declarations.

flatbuffers.format.wrapComments.description: Reflow long line comments at whitespace boundaries. Block comments and doc comments are left untouched.

flatbuffers.format.commentWidth.description: Wrap column for `wrapComments`. Defaults to `lineWidth` when unset.
